label: Cold stone, composition omissions and first-being act priority facts, checked
description: Controls for the first-being version of act priority. Control.ColdStone witnesses that the strong reading strictly strengthens the first-being version, jointly with non-overlap and the four composition-route premises. Control.CompositionOmissions shows that each composition premise is needed. Control.Facts proves the strength order, the equivalence of the first-being version with the q.3 a.1 conclusion given non-overlap (and that non-overlap is needed for that direction), and that the strong reading with non-overlap and a simple-priority-to-G bridge gives every being in potency a distinct G-predecessor in act in that respect. Model-witnessed and general implications only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible.
